recommended_bio: Friends of Friends are an Australian alternative rock band from South East Queensland, combining indie-rock guitars, pop hooks, electronic textures and punk energy. Their releases include Real Life, Right Now and Synthetic Flower Chainsaw.
location_notes: Official Apple Music lists Brisbane, QLD, Australia; official triple j Unearthed lists Gold Coast, QLD. Independent 2023 Mixdown and AU Review interviews describe Brisbane, while 2025 AMPED/HIVE describe Gold Coast. South East Queensland is the safest umbrella; ask band to standardise profile location before pursuing local queries.
genre_notes: Official triple j genres Indie/Rock/Pop and Attention track Indie/Punk. Apple Music Alternative. HIVE alt-rock/pop-rock. Phrase as alternative rock with indie, pop and punk influences; no need to claim a purist punk identity.

comparison_notes.the_1975: Strong: band origin interview in Mixdown, independent HIVE EP review, independent scenestr live review, plus AMPED interview.
comparison_notes.sam_fender: Specific: Alterwave 2023 interview describes one upcoming single as homage to Springsteen/Sam Fender. AU Review lists him as dream touring partner. Suitable for an honestly framed influences/listening guide with citations, not a fabricated critic endorsement.
comparison_notes.other_artists: Cure (Frank's I Like Ya songwriting story), Nine Inch Nails (Barnaby's repeated production influence), Blink-182/U2 (AMPED), Wet Leg/Courting (HIVE comparisons).

avoid_claims: Do not state guaranteed search/AI rank or 'number one Brisbane band'.
Do not treat band-written profile accolades as independently verified BBC/Kerrang coverage.
Do not fabricate current members, formation year or forthcoming tour dates from inconsistent historical sources.
Do not confuse the band with 5 Seconds of Summer's Friends of Friends philanthropic brand.
